description: Every game system the mashup touches.

rows.description: InkwellWorld.exe next to Terraria.exe loads Terraria in-process (x86, large-address-aware), applies Harmony patches, then runs Terraria.WindowsLaunch.Main. Game files are never changed.

Melty ownCopies finds Cuphead on disk (game need not run); CupPrepare extracts only named cuphead_/mugman_/chalice_ Sprites from atlas_player + atlas_chalice + mugshots. PNGs load as Texture2D; DrawPlayer prefix replaces the Terraria body.
On Terraria character create, offer Cuphead, Mugman and Ms. Chalice. Choosing one applies fallback vanity and stores the Cuphead kit id for that player file.
While playing as a Cuphead cast member: Peashooter, EX, parry, dash/roll, Chalice double-jump. Spawn already armed.
Parry on X / Square-equivalent (keyboard X), dash on Left Shift; shots on mouse. Documented on first launch.
